digest.component_or_area: LLM provider integration / pydantic-ai Bedrock support
propositions: Rebar must support AWS Bedrock as a native first-class LLM provider using pydantic-ai's BedrockConverseModel, not via an OpenAI-compatible gateway.

Bedrock prompt caching must be enabled exactly for bedrock_cache_instructions and bedrock_cache_tool_definitions (two keys for parity with Anthropic direct), with silent cache failure (zero read/write counters) logged as a warning.

The temperature sampling parameter is rejected (400 ValidationException: deprecated) by some Bedrock model IDs like us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-7 but not others; rebar must omit it based on a per-model capability override table keyed by exact model ID.

Bedrock provider errors matching the shape (400 + ValidationException + sampling parameter name + rejection word) must translate to LLMConfigError naming the model ID and both remedies rather than generic LLMUnavailableError.

The [bedrock] optional extra must be added to dev dependencies so unit tests run in CI without boto3 in the default [agents] install, while the Bedrock builder lives in a new src/rebar/llm/bedrock_model.py leaf module to respect the 300-LOC cap on providers.py.
